title: Trump blocks chips deal, cites security, China-related concerns
Trump administration halts immigrant visa processing from 75 countries
summary: The state department cites welfare use as it pauses visa processing for Brazil, Iran, Russia, Somalia and othersPeople affected by the US visa freeze: share your experienceThe DonaldTrump administrationhas indefinitely suspended immigrant visa processing for people from 75 countries, marking one of its most expansive efforts yet to restrict legal pathways to the United States.The freeze, which takes effect on 21 January, targets applicants officials deem likely to become a “public charge” – who they describe as people who may rely on government benefits for basic needs.Continue reading...
